caption:
Toto throws the ball dozens of times at the dog park, and lately his shoulder twinges with every throw.

Throwing isn't just the shoulder. Stepping forward and turning your body lets your legs and trunk help, which can take some load off the shoulder.

Hybi's 1-minute fetch prep: big arm circles, 10 each way, step with the opposite foot, and take a short break every 10 throws. A ball launcher can share the load too. Stop if your arm feels weak.

Trouble lifting your arm, pain at night, or no change after two weeks are worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio
